stages.name: Stage 1 - Foundation
stages.subtitle: Build the Habit
stages.goal: Daily corrective work for 3+ weeks. Pain centralizing.
focus: Surya Namaskar, Bird Dog, Glute Bridge

gate.description: 14 Full workouts + Pain trending Better + 60% consistency

stages.name: Stage 2 - Motor Control
stages.subtitle: Core Endurance
stages.goal: Add push-ups, side planks, bodyweight squats. 25+ min sessions.
focus: McGill Big 3: Bird Dog, Curl-Up, Side Plank
Bodyweight squat pattern and hip hinge

gate.description: 25 Full workouts + 30 pushups/session + 25 min average duration

stages.name: Stage 3 - Graded Loading
stages.subtitle: Light Resistance
stages.goal: Introduce resistance bands and light dumbbells. No spinal compression.

gate.description: 40 Full workouts + 5000 total volume + 30 min average duration

stages.name: Stage 4 - Strength Building
stages.subtitle: Progressive Overload
stages.goal: Structured programs with progressive weight increase.
focus: Trap bar deadlift or spinal-safe hip hinge

stages.name: Stage 5 - Maintenance
stages.subtitle: Lifetime Practice
stages.goal: Ongoing strength training with daily corrective warmups.
focus: Annual mobility and nerve health check-ins
